purpose: Argon-designed procedural fallback proportions; not a substitute for a sculpted textured human asset.
design_notes: Parameter tuning on basic primitives will only produce a cleaner stylized procedural mannequin; true photorealism requires a sculpted human mesh, PBR skin shaders, and normal/albedo textures.
Merge the cranium and jaw into a single continuous high-segment (48x48) sphere deformed via vertex tapering (jaw_width_ratio=0.76) to eliminate the intersecting jaw seam.
Reduce hair_cap_angle to 0.36*PI and tilt it slightly back so the forehead and eyebrows are fully exposed.
Flatten eye_white_depth to 0.0035, narrow eye_spacing to 0.035m, and recess the eyes slightly into the head surface to stop eyeball bulging.
